mechanism: Levofloxacin may increase propylthiouracil levels through potential CYP450 inhibition and displacement from protein binding, while fluoroquinolones are associated with QT prolongation risk which may be compounded in hyperthyroid states.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests and clinical response; consider ECG monitoring given potential QT effects; adjust propylthiouracil dosing if needed based on TSH/free T4 levels.
